<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier with two levels of registers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit multiplicand.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit multiplier.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit product output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter>size = 4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="partial_product_reg" width_description="[7:0]" depth="4">Register to store partial products.</reg>
        <reg id="sum_reg" width_description="[7:0]" depth="1">Register to store the sum of partial products.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Extend input signals
        wire [7:0] a_extended = {mul_a, 4'b0};
        wire [7:0] b_extended = {mul_b, 4'b0};

        // Generate partial products and store in register
        genvar i;
        generate
            for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) begin : partial_product_gen
                always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
                    if (!rst_n) begin
                        partial_product_reg[i] <= 8'b0;
                    end else begin
                        if (b_extended[i]) begin
                            partial_product_reg[i] <= a_extended << i;
                        end else begin
                            partial_product_reg[i] <= 8'b0;
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        endgenerate

        // Add partial products and store in register
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                sum_reg <= 8'b0;
            end else begin
                sum_reg <= partial_product_reg[0] + partial_product_reg[1] + partial_product_reg[2] + partial_product_reg[3];
            end
        end

        // Assign final product
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_out <= 8'b0;
            end else begin
                mul_out <= sum_reg;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
